_metric_defs.onset_err: fraction (%) of MATCHED GT notes flagged OnsetError(shift|scale) by MUSTER
_metric_defs.offset_err: fraction (%) of MATCHED GT notes flagged OffsetError by MUSTER
_metric_defs.tuplet_tag: (onset_tick%24)%3!=0 OR (dur_tick%3!=0) on TPQN=24 grid; ==music21 on Mozart
_metric_defs.self_consistency: note-weighted combine of tuplet+nontuplet == harness OnsetER/OffsetER

_findings.method: Per-note MUSTER decomposition from the Nakamura ScoreMatchEvaluation_VoicePlus err_detail + auto_match files (the same C++ pipeline the released harness runs). OnsetER/OffsetER are RATES = (#matched GT notes flagged with that error)/(#matched GT notes), matched=nGT-nMiss. We bucket matched GT notes and their per-note onset/offset error flags by tuplet status (TPQN=24 grid: (onset%24)%3!=0 OR dur%3!=0; ==music21 tuplet count exactly on Mozart 36 & Scriabin 99).
_findings.self_consistency: OffsetER: note-weighted recombination == harness aggregate EXACTLY on 14/14 (gap 0.0000). OnsetER: attributable per-note lines recombine EXACTLY; MUSTER's headline OnsetER adds a RhythmCorrectionCost residual of 0-1 unattributable cost-unit/piece (total 5 across 14 pieces).
_findings.headline: ONSET placement error on TUPLET notes is far higher than on non-tuplet notes on classically-notated pieces where binary rhythm dominates: Schumann 9.0x, Scriabin 5.0x, Mozart 5.0x, Beethoven 4.8x, Brahms 3.7x, Liszt 3.4x. A 'good' aggregate MeanER (e.g. Mozart 5.9, Beethoven 9.0) co-exists with 25-50% onset error on that piece's tuplet notes -- the aggregate BURIES the tuplet failure. OFFSET error does NOT show this penalty (comparable or lower on tuplets). On tuplet-SATURATED pieces (Ravel/Chopin/Prokofiev/Bach, 96-99.9% tuplet) the ratio inverts: the model defaults to the tuplet grid and the rare binary notes become the misfits.
_findings.aggregate_caveat: The corpus-pooled tuplet/nontuplet ratio (released onset 1.66x, offset 0.80x) is confounded by mix effects (dense-tuplet pieces dominate the pooled tuplet bucket while their tiny non-tuplet buckets are outlier-heavy). The per-piece view and the BALANCED subset (8 pieces, 2-80% tuplet, both buckets>=20 notes: onset 1.80x micro / 2.61x macro) are the honest headline.
